platformLimits.reason: Dify credentials cannot fetch a model catalogue (no network call at config time), so the model picker is a curated static list from facts/models-dev-sample.json plus a Custom… entry. The provider picker is Dify's engine enum (3 built-in engines: google_free, openai_compatible, deepl); there is no models.dev provider merge at runtime.
Dify's I18nObject accepts exactly four locales (en_US, zh_Hans, ja_JP, pt_BR); every label, help text and placeholder in this plugin exists in those four and only those.
